title: Preserve attributable state-bound subject history
statement: The Work record storage Module shall select bounded retained records using explicit project-qualified subject associations and one coherent history state, preserving original provenance, coverage limitations and safe continuation without operational mutation.

what.problem: Cross-Change selection can lose identity, hide missing retained scope or mix states across pages.

why.rationale: SR-078 requires this distinct accountable contribution; reuse current record, admission and authority ownership while qualifying new history semantics separately.

stakeholders: Engineers and reviewers inspecting recorded work
Engineering agents and operational record maintainers

conditions: When an explicitly selected subject-history lookup or continuation is requested; state metadata also constrains the cooperating target-profile writers.

contexts: MOD-018 composition through IF-004 and IF-003; local associated project records under history-selection.md.

how.approach: Use explicit recorded identity, coherent read state, literal filters and bounded complete outcomes under the owning history contract.

how_much.scope: Finite retained project scope; no exhaustive past, automatic migration, distributed history or implementation/adoption claim.

acceptance_criteria: Use explicit recorded subject associations and literal record filters; preserve originating Change, record and original subject bases across revisions and renames without inferring identity or finding relevance from paths, names or prose.
Distinguish available complete no-match from absent, incompatible, unreadable, unmapped or partially retained scope; page exhaustion cannot erase retention or association gaps.

Read state, associations, coverage and facts from one read-only transaction under the qualified access/fence contract; lookup cannot initialize storage, perform recovery/migration, repair associations or change engineering records.

Bind authenticated continuation to project, activation/generation, normalized selection/order/page bound and unique last tuple; same-state pages are deterministic, while changed or altered continuation returns no page units and requires fresh selection.

Advance history generation atomically with every target-profile record/association/coverage mutation, fence incompatible writers and rotate activation/key on replacement or restoration so change-and-revert and restored old bytes cannot revive an earlier cursor.
Preserve selective retention and old subject meanings; explicit association/profile migration and writer qualification are prerequisites rather than hidden lookup effects.
constraints: Historical judgments do not establish current applicability or authority. Existing v2/v4 contracts remain independently versioned and unchanged by this target Design.

sources.basis: Define recorded subject association, coherent bounded history selection and state-bound continuation through existing command/storage owners. Target Design only; current ordinary queries, schema and installed capability remain unchanged.
